description: This source file defines the OverlayService class for an Android app, responsible for creating and managing an overlay view that can intercept user touches in different modes (safe mode with touch blocking, or passthrough). It handles overlay lifecycle, notification setup, and touch event logic.

classes.name: OverlayService
classes.description: Android Service that creates an overlay view which can intercept or pass through user touches, with support for foreground notification to keep the overlay alive.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used for this service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the overlay service, sets up notification channel and foreground service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles intent to add overlay with specified mode and opacity.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by removing overlay view.

methods.name: addOverlay
methods.description: Creates and adds the overlay view to the window manager with configuration based on safety mode and opacity.

methods.name: removeOverlay
methods.description: Removes the overlay view if it exists.
